changelog: ✦ Fix Jembatan Eksekusi Market Intel: Sinkronisasi live data kontekstual Dealing Range (Harga, Range High/Low, EQ, BSL/SSL) langsung dari engine /api/scalper-setups.
✦ Eliminasi Hardcode 4185: Membuang total angka lama 4185.66 pada Market Intel, digantikan perhitungan dinamis live real-time.

✦ Integrasi POI Anatomi Lengkap ICT (OB, FVG & Liquidity): Card SELL SETUP & BUY SETUP kini menampilkan Order Block (OB), Fair Value Gap (FVG), 50% Mean Threshold (MT)/CE, Target Likuiditas (SSL/BSL), dan Batas Invalidasi secara utuh dan transparan.
